autoRegistration.title: Auto-Registration
autoRegistration.desc: Automatically fills and submits your visa application on evisatraveller.mfa.ir the moment slots open — faster than any human can.

monitoring.title: 24/7 Site Monitoring
monitoring.desc: Continuously watches the MFA portal for availability changes, downtime, and new appointment slots every few seconds.

notifications.title: Instant Notifications
notifications.desc: Get alerted via push notification the second the site comes back online or a new slot becomes available — never miss a window.

vault.title: Form Data Vault

tracker.title: Application Tracker
tracker.desc: Monitor the status of every submission in real-time from a clean dashboard — pending, approved, or rejected at a glance.

retry.title: Smart Retry Logic
retry.desc: If a submission fails due to server errors or timeouts, the system intelligently retries with exponential back-off automatically.

steps.subtitle: No technical knowledge required. Set up your profile once, then let the system work.

step1.title: Create Your Profile
step1.desc: Enter your passport details, nationality, date of birth, and visa requirements once. Your data is encrypted and stored securely.

step2.title: Set Your Preferences
step2.desc: Choose your target visa type, preferred travel window, and notification preferences. Configure how aggressively to monitor for slots.

step3.title: Activate Monitoring
step3.desc: Flip the switch. Our system begins watching evisatraveller.mfa.ir around the clock and alerts you to any availability changes instantly.

step4.title: Auto-Submit or Confirm
